headline: Trading Venue Intake Jumps To 617.7 Million Dollars, Led By Bitget And Gate
narrative: The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, was a 617.7 million dollar net inflow, versus a 65.6 million dollar inflow on the prior print, which means dollars are arriving again on venues where holders can sell. Bitget took in 304.9 million dollars and Gate took in 229.8 million dollars, which means those two venues are taking the bulk of the new arrivals. Binance posted a 67.1 million dollar outflow, against a 30.3 million dollar intake on the prior print, which means the largest venue is sending dollars out while Bitget and Gate take them in.
author: jordan
